row.proto: void Ne_StringId_FormatAndIntern(void *out_id, int32_t max_len, const char *fmt, ...)
row.notes: (lib) Variadic helper: measures with vsnprintf, formats into an alloca buffer truncated to max_len, computes FNV-1a 64 of the text, interns it in g_Ne_StringTable via Ne_StringPool_InternByHash and writes {interned char pointer, hash} to out_id. Standard way the engine builds hashed names such as resource names.
